messages:
Maya (Finance): Heads up — StratusHealth flagged their Q3 invoice for private deployment. They say platform fee looks doubled and the true-up is way higher than expected. Can we confirm?
Ethan (RevOps): I see the invoice. There are two platform_fee line items: PLAT-FEE-MAIN and PLAT-FEE-RECON. Suspect a mapping/regression after the support-tier reclassification in July.
Priya (Billing): Noted. I pulled the metering logs, there was a metric_key rename during the support tier migration: 'redwood.platform_fee' -> 'redwood.platform_fee_v2'. Our ETL kept both tags and treated them as separate charges.
Liam (CS): Customer called this morning, they're worried. They upgraded support tier mid-quarter (Standard -> Premium) but were told proration would be applied. Now invoice shows full Premium platform fee + a recon true-up.
Maya (Finance): Can we calculate the correct proration and the duplicate charge amount quickly? Stratus is asking for a credit before renewal.
Priya (Billing): Quick extract of invoice lines:
```
line_id,desc,qty,unit_price,amount
1001,PLATFORM_FEE_STANDARD,1,2000,2000
1002,PLATFORM_FEE_PREMIUM,1,4000,4000
1003,PLAT-FEE-RECON (duplicate tag),1,4000,4000
1004,SUPPORT_TIER_PRORATION_CREDIT,-1,1500,-1500
```
I think line 1003 is the unintended duplicate from metric_key mapping.
Ethan (RevOps): If we remove 1003 and apply correct proration (they moved to Premium halfway through quarter), the net delta is roughly: -4000 (remove dup) + 1500 (proration credit already applied) => -2500 owed to customer.
Maya (Finance): Proposal: issue a one-time credit of $2,500 and mark the billing incident. Also, fix the ETL mapping so future invoices don't duplicate. Approve? @Ethan @Priya
Ethan (RevOps): Approve. Also recommend we tag this as a waived platform_fee true-up so renewals don't auto-escalate.
Priya (Billing): Approve. I'll push a corrected invoice and create a remediation ticket for the ETL change (internal ticket: BILL-8472). I'll DM Liam with timeline for the corrected invoice.
Liam (CS): Thanks — I'll tell the customer we'll issue the credit today and send the updated invoice by EOD. They appreciate the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
BillingBot: Invoice 84621 status updated -> corrected_invoice_pending by Priya at 2005555402
Maya (Finance): Great — please add the credit memo to the renewal proposal so ARR looks right. Close the loop once invoice is out.
